tw-blackburn-gordon-1897.st: Legal: sec. 36 T43N R11W, 160 acres, 10 mi SE of Gordon on the Totagatic; barn 40 rods from the house, path to the river ford. The killer picked the locks and took cash hidden in the bedding (about $500-1,200); a wallet was never found. Papers said the bulk of his ~$75,000 was in Stillwater and St. Paul banks and in lands, so a buried hoard is doubtful. Estate: a special administrator was appointed and the residue went to the heirs in 1898; no digging was reported.
tw-blackburn-gordon-1897.t: Look-only, graves at the house site: his wife was buried under the house and he was buried beside her at the home in Oct 1897. The 500 m circle covers the 1938 farmstead about 400 m west of the pin.
